title: The Lord Is My Song
summary: Keep a list of God's victories and recount them. Glad songs of salvation are not quiet songs. Jesus, our undefeated champion, deserves our loudest praise.
exhortation: Do you have a list of victories in your life that you can recount every day? We should do this more. I know I should. We go to God with our needs, as we should, but we should also recount the victories we've seen in our lives. Are you excited about the future? We have a glorious future ahead of us, and those victories remind us of it.

I love the phrase "The Lord is my strength and my song." Jesus is our song. He is our champion. Picture a boxer coming into the ring. What's happening? Loud music, and everyone he represents is cheering and shouting. There's a time for quiet, contemplative music, but this is not it. This is a time for big drums and big guitars, a time to sing at the top of our lungs: there he is, Jesus, undefeated, coming in power.

That's the moment this psalm is describing. Glad songs of salvation are not quiet songs. Our enemies cower, cover their ears and run for the hills when they hear the war cry of the people of God shouting the praises of Jesus. Heaven will be loud. How could it not be, when the saints join the angels in praising the Lamb who was slain, risen in victory over sin and death? No one will ask to turn it down. What a glorious thing it is to worship Jesus. We don't need to apologize for being loud as we sing about the victories he has won for us.
prayer: Lord, in times of hardship and in times of joy, you have been faithful. Help us go back and remember, even write it down in a little book if that's what it takes, because we of all people should be filled with an ever-present sense of gratitude toward you. How could we be harsh or unkind toward others when we have been forgiven so much?

Fill our hearts with thankfulness today. Let there be a joy inexpressible on our faces that others notice and ask, "What is it that fills you with joy?", especially when they know our circumstances wouldn't normally put a smile on our faces. Your peace surpasses all understanding. Fill our hearts with thankfulness today, Lord. We pray in your name.
